title: Budget parameters
intro: Rates and adjustments that feed each project's pre-generated budget.

fields.laborFixedHint: Commissioning and management: added once per project.
fields.laborPerPanelHint: Multiplied by the number of modules in the design.
fields.inflationPctHint: Covers market price fluctuation. It compounds with each equipment's own inflation and never shows as a concept: the budget only reflects the final price.
